facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports that the 2025-2026 Finance Law (arts. 142-143) requires every titleholder to apply for a secure electronic land title, with the land titles directorate (DTFCN) receiving files at Bujumbura, Gitega, Makamba and Ngozi until 30 April 2026.
